query: I was out walking my golden retriever this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a community garden, trampled a whole bed of marigolds, and I ended up apologizing to the gardener for twenty minutes. On the way home I stopped at the corner bakeshop and picked up a loaf of sourdough and a blueberry scone, the scone was still warm and I ate half of it before I even got back to my apartment. I just sat down to make a work call but my mobile service isn’t working at all—my APN settings seem to be glitching out, I think my line might be suspended because I had an overdue bill and my contract just ended, and also my SIM card is locked with a PIN I can’t remember right now, can you help me fix this?
